name: albert-claude-desktop-bridge
description: Builds the bridge Albert puts in its Claude Desktop install file: mcp-remote, pinned, bundled into one file.

scripts.build: esbuild entry.mjs --bundle --minify --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --legal-comments=linked --banner:js="import { createRequire as __albertRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __albertRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=../../assets/claude-desktop/bridge.mjs
